dialogues.text: #It seems your jokes have improved with practice, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Absolutely. Finally, someone to share the load.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Ah, you know what? Collei's helping out the Akademiya, but I haven't had the chance to check on her. Why don't you do me a favor, and... go do that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hold on, I thought you were having me over for dinner?
